ports: Animated character: fullscreen HD anchor (29,39), model scale 12, fixed -40/10 look, body-relative rotation and 30/5 render-frame timers from Gui.cpp.
Minecart riding: fresh Use press to exit, no jump/crouch dismount from controller, subtype-specific Ride/Open/Use/Hit and Mine actions from Minecraft.cpp.

PS3/PS4 Common audio: 22 shared overworld tracks for menus/Survival/Creative; four Nether tracks; stock End dragon track; GetRandomishTrack bounded retries and random 0..3599 audio-frame delay. Music is retained when loading/leaving worlds.

Splash: copied Common/Media/splashes.txt; source holiday indexes and excluded message; original Splash region (612,126,500,50) at 720p and 1.5x placement at 1080p; -17 degree rotation and 1000 ms pulse.
adaptations: Java logo is retained as requested; source splash is overlaid at its original normalized coordinates.
Java 1.11 native cart physics, server input packets and containers remain authoritative; this ports LCE interaction controls and HUD rather than replacing the entire C++ minecart simulation.
Java renders native player skin/armour/cape layers directly and omits the world shadow/fire pass, matching isGuiRender without mutating player fire state.
The optional coordinate HUD is placed beside the animated character when it is visible. Split-screen player models are outside this single-player-window port.

Music uses corresponding tracks installed with Minecraft, not redistributed console Bink files. Xbox-specific historical timer/track differences and mash-up pack music are not selected. Optional Moog City 2/Beginning 2 menu overrides remain available; LCE Mix is the default.
Legacy4J extended creative presets are translated to pre-typed-array 1.11 SNBT; post-1.11 ominous banner is omitted.

Orbis/PS3 invoke music updates from the presentation loop. LceAudioClock maintains their 60 Hz target cadence independently of PC FPS; the source random(20*60*3) expression is preserved as a frame count, not interpreted as 20 Hz world ticks.

Java world pause excludes only Console Audio's owned music stream from the native paused-channel list. Its native playback status and volume remain live while world updates are suspended; track completion retains LCE playlist/delay rules. Level exit clears stopped world channels from Forge's resume list. Minecraft.cpp's soundEngine tick remains outside the paused-world branch.

User-requested music during the rating card starts through the normal game sound engine once ready. Intro progress/wait callbacks tick its existing playlist; startup definition refreshes preserve an owned queued stream. The same stream crosses remaining logos and main menu; later resource reloads retain native behavior.
